The primary biological variable for the MS analysis is the use of ionizing radiation (IR) to induce the DNA damage response (DDR) to facilitate the capture of phosphorylated BRCT-interacting partners. While the paper describes extensive genetic perturbations (shRNA knockdown of CTDP1), these were used for functional assays (DR-GFP, survival, xenografts) and not for the primary mass spectrometry dataset (PXD009541), which focused on the CTDP1 BRCT domain interactome.
